title: LifestealShop
description: This is a plugin that works with lifestealz and let u buy items with ur hearts with /shop
body:
# HeartMarket

HeartMarket is a Paper plugin that adds a heart-based shop system for LifeStealZ servers. Players can buy and sell items using hearts instead of a normal economy currency.

## Features

- Heart-based shop economy
- LifeStealZ integration
- Works on Minecraft 1.21.x
- Configurable shop categories
- Admin GUI for managing items and categories
- Player item listings
- Custom prices in hearts
- Permission-based shop access
- Optional purchase confirmation GUI
- Purchase history
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Command rewards for kits or custom actions
- Full item data preservation

## Full Item Support

Shop items are stored with their complete item data, so special items stay intact when listed and bought.

This includes:
- Custom item names
- Lore
- Enchantments
- Custom model data
- Container contents
- Bundle contents
- Modern Paper item components
- NBT-style item data

For example, a custom-named barrel or a special bundle will be saved and delivered as the same item through the shop.

## Requirements

- Paper server
- Minecraft 1.21.x
- LifeStealZ
- Java 17+

## Commands

- `/shop` - Open the shop
- `/heartmarket` - Open the shop
- `/heartmarket admin` - Open the admin panel
- `/heartmarket reload` - Reload the plugin
- `/heartmarket give <player> <item>` - Give a shop item
- `/heartmarket history` - View purchase history

## Permissions

- `heartmarket.use` - Use the shop
- `heartmarket.admin` - Access admin features
- `heartmarket.reload` - Reload the plugin
- `heartmarket.history` - View purchase history
- `heartmarket.bypass` - Bypass category restrictions
